Tenebrous Form
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Obtenebration
Cost: 1 blood
[obt] +1 stealth.
[OBT] As above, and minions without Obtenebration must pay 1 blood to
attempt to block.

It was mentioned somewhere here before, but sounds too good to be true:

Allies cannot block actions modified by Tenebrous Form superior,
because they have to pay *blood* to attempt, but they dont have any
(they have only *life*).True?

Thank you
